intro_h2: Foundation & Structural Work in Los Angeles County
intro: Everything above ground depends on what's below it. Palm Crest Builders performs foundation and structural work across Los Angeles County — new foundations for additions and ADUs, seismic retrofits, framing, beam installations, and repairs for settling or damaged structures. As a licensed general building contractor working with licensed structural engineers, we make sure your home is safe, level, and built to carry the loads California code requires.

body_extra.heading: Seismic Retrofitting in Southern California
body_extra.text: Older homes across Los Angeles — especially those built before modern codes — often have cripple walls or soft-story conditions that perform poorly in an earthquake. A seismic retrofit bolts your home to its foundation, braces cripple walls, and reinforces weak points. It's one of the highest-value structural upgrades a Southern California homeowner can make, and we handle the engineering, permits, and construction as one package.

faqs.q: How do I know if I have foundation problems?
faqs.a: Common signs include sloping floors, sticking doors and windows, stair-step cracks in stucco or drywall, and gaps at baseboards. We'll assess and give you an honest evaluation.
Yes. We perform cripple-wall and soft-story seismic retrofits with engineered hardware, permits, and inspections.

faqs.q: Is structural work permitted and engineered?
faqs.a: Always. Structural and foundation work requires engineering and permits — we manage both so the work is safe, legal, and documented.
